scene.note: The pack keeps its own items and its own rule, so nobody carries more than their limit.

steps.note: An item comes to the pack with its name and weight.
An item that weighs nothing, or would take the pack over its owner's limit, is refused, and the message says why.
An item that fits goes into the pack's own items.
The pack holds its items, whoever put them there.
Every time the weight is asked for, the pack adds up what its items weigh.
Dougie reads the weight like any other value, without brackets.
Dougie asks for one item out of the pack.
The item leaves the pack's own items.
Dougie gets back what it weighed, or a refusal that names an item the pack never held.
The first team's pack is packed.
A new pack is made for the same owner, with every item but one.
The two packs keep their items apart, so changing one never changes the other.
